comment:
* WatchKey implementation that encapsulates a map of the entries of the
     * entries in the directory. Polling the key causes it to re-scan the
     * directory and queue keys when entries are added, modified, or deleted.

variables.name: poller
variables.comment: the result of the periodic task that causes this key to be polled

variables.name: valid
variables.comment: indicates if the key is valid

variables.name: tickCount
variables.comment: used to detect files that have been deleted

methods.name: void enable(Set<? extends WatchEvent.Kind<?>> events, long period)
synchronized void poll()
methods.comment:
* Polls the directory to detect for new files, modified files, or
         * deleted files.

methodNames: void enable(Set<? extends WatchEvent.Kind<?>> events, long period)
